cohort: Pregnant women delivering at Zimba Mission Hospital, Zambia in 2017, including 1704 normal pregnancies and 42 with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy.
finding: All 8 cases of eclampsia occurred outside of the hospital setting in primigravida women aged 15-23 years old at 35-40 weeks gestation; no eclampsia occurred after magnesium sulfate administration was initiated.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed in 7 out of 8 cases of eclampsia.
